articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu says there is 'vigilante effort' in West Bank, not pushed by settlers
articles.summary: Netanyahu stated during an NBC interview that settler violence in the West Bank is driven by about 150 juvenile delinquents rather than the broader settler community, emphasizing that 99% of settlers are law-abiding citizens.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates concerns about US-Turkey F-35 sale
articles.summary: Netanyahu told CNN that he expressed concerns to President Trump about the potential F-35 sale to Turkey, arguing it could disrupt the regional balance of power and noting Turkey's ties to the Muslim Brotherhood.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: 'My relationship with President Donald Trump is excellent'
articles.summary: Netanyahu asserted in a Fox News interview that the US-Israel alliance is strong and that he and Trump agree on 99% of issues, though they may occasionally discuss disagreements openly on matters like Iran policy.

articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu is building his election campaign around ending the political boycott against him and forming a broader unity coalition, arguing that Israel faces challenges too profound to be managed by another narrow government.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu backs ending US military aid to build Israel armaments independence
articles.summary: Netanyahu reiterated his commitment to phase out American military assistance and develop Israel's own independent armaments manufacturing network, saying the country needs to build strength and stand on its own feet.
